title: Ecological risk assessor.
bodyText: The department may establish a permanent exempt position for an ecological risk assessor for the purpose of assessing ecological risks and damages. The position shall be appointed by the director without regard to chapter 76.
bodyHtml: §128D-2.6  Ecological risk assessor.  The department may establish a permanent exempt position for an ecological risk assessor for the purpose of assessing ecological risks and damages.  The position shall be appointed by the director without regard to chapter 76. [L 1999, c 211, §2; am L 2000, c 253, §150; am L 2015, c 185, §8]
